question: Who inaugurated the expanded Guna Head Post Office and Passport Seva Kendra, built at ₹43.18 lakh over 1154 sq. ft.?
solution:
The correct answer is J**yotiraditya M. Scindia**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia**, Union Minister of Communications and Development of North Eastern Region, inaugurated the **expanded Guna Head Post Office** and **Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK)** on **January 11, 2025**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The new building spans **1154 square feet** and was built at a cost of **Rs. 43.18 lakhs**.
 
• Scindia discussed the **Postal Department's transformation**, **Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana**, and the technology-driven **India Post Payments Bank**.
 
• The **new POPSK** enhances citizen access to essential services, reducing travel distances and aligning with the government's vision of improving public service delivery.
 
• Dignitaries such as **Shri Govind Singh Rajput**, **Shri Pannalal Shakya**, and **Shri Vineet Mathur** participated in the inauguration event.
